reasoning_input.question_text: Find a normal vector to the plane containing vectors u = (1, 2, 3) and v = (4, 5, 6).

student_steps.content: Normal vector n = u × v = det([[i, j, k], [1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])

steps.description: Recognize that normal vector is given by cross product u × v
Set up 3x3 determinant definition for cross product
Compute components of u × v correctly: i(-3), j(6), k(-3)
State final normal vector n = (-3, 6, -3) or parallel vector (1, -2, 1)
